acceptance: A repair cycle with no recorded red repro test is refused at the build floor (red first)
A recorded red test lets the build start
The record names the incident id
fix: The build phase of a repair cycle refuses to start without a recorded red result for the item (the test fails on base, and it names the incident).
summary: Spec section 18 step 4: TDD writes a red test that reproduces the incident before build. No gate checks it today.
title: Self-healing X16d: a T1 repair cycle needs a red reproduction test before build
